batch_size_sensitivity.note: Per-event adapter energy is NOT batch-size-invariant: fixed per-call kernel-launch overhead amortizes over more real work at larger batch, so batch=80 (this evaluation run) understates the per-event cost of a real single-patient deployment (batch=1). Reported at both extremes rather than citing only the more favourable batch=80 number.
